artifacts.title: Trace Compass Test Traces: ROS2 simple system / trace-example-2-20220407155648
artifacts.creator: Christophe Bédard (trace contribution), Eclipse Trace Compass project (distribution)
artifacts.license: EPL-2.0. Repository NOTICE covers the program and accompanying materials. This batch shares newly computed statistics and source locators.
artifacts.evidence_level: measured trace files decoded; not physical plant measurements
artifacts.signals: Single-host LTTng CTF 1.8 capture of three ROS node processes on eight CPU streams. Source /topic_a DDS writer and relay /topic_b writer each have unique source stamps per topic. Successful rmw_take reports a matching source stamp. Pair RCL publish with DDS write in thread by matching rcl_publish message address to dds:write_pre data and matching writer at write_pre and write. Resolve subscription callbacks using the initialization handle chain. Pair successful take with subsequent subscription callback of matching topic/thread and callback_end. The relay publishes exactly once inside each matched incoming callback on the same thread.
artifacts.clock: Clock metadata monotonic 1 GHz, UUID 507ad184-257b-4164-b479-27ac6cfeb1fe. Differences computed exclusively from Babeltrace event clock cycles. The epoch-like DDS source timestamp is solely an equality key, not subtracted from the event clock.
artifacts.scope: 99,338 events. 1,986 complete application chains. DDS write-to-take includes transport, queueing and execution until take. Single host; three processes. The source describes a trivial message flow. Endpoints are software nodes. Unmatched sends and takes do not identify network drops.
artifacts.historical_extension: projects/my-phd/evidence/g1-collection/follow-ups/2026-11-21-message-age-control-updates/ros/caret-source.json cites addition d5fb44e6 as an uncounted software-test lead. This pass verifies all CTF files and derives two-hop linkages and timing.

artifacts.title: tracetools_analysis callback-duration example: converted_pingpong
artifacts.creator: Christophe Bédard (sample revision), ros-tracing/tracetools_analysis contributors
artifacts.license: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE; no separate file-level terms found). Raw example is referenced at source.
artifacts.evidence_level: published converted measured event stream decoded
artifacts.signals: 248 primitive event dictionaries include two process IDs and 91 completable callback-start/end pairs. One pair is internal /parameter_events. Remaining 90 comprise 30 source timer, 30 /ping subscriber, and 30 /pong subscriber callbacks. Runtime pairs use process, thread and registered callback handles. No per-message DDS write/take, publish event or sequence number appears. Ordered triples are grouped between consecutive source timer starts after filtering the internal callback.
artifacts.clock: Converted Babeltrace _timestamp in nanoseconds. Single launch example declares both processes together. Unlike the CTF release, converted file retains no host or clock metadata. No cross-host comparison.
artifacts.scope: Software timing under ping–pong test workload with extra work requested in both nodes. Callback start-to-start spacings depend on workload and scheduling. No absolute network, message-specific RTT or motion latency inferred.
